import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gslcblas = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so')

# Define the function
cblas_scasum = gslcblas.cblas_scasum
cblas_scasum.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float), ctypes.c_int]
cblas_scasum.restype = ctypes.c_float

def compute_scasum(complex_list, incX):
    # Flatten the complex list into real and imaginary parts
    flat_list = np.array([val for complex_num in complex_list for val in (complex_num.real, complex_num.imag)], dtype=np.float32)
    # Convert to ctypes array
    c_array = flat_list.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float))
    # Call the C function
    result = cblas_scasum(len(complex_list), c_array, incX)
    return result

    complex_list = [complex(1, 2), complex(3, 4), complex(-5, -6)]
    incX = 1
    assert np.isclose(compute_scasum(complex_list, incX), 21.0), "Test case 1 failed"
